Pipeline step: generate meta cells

step_metacells_sc.Rd

Wraps the meta cell generators as an ScStep. Unlike the other steps this one changes the class of the object: it takes a SingleCells or SingleCellsSubset and returns a MetaCells(). Steps that follow it need MetaCells methods, which validate_pipeline() checks up front.

Combined with apply_pipeline_per_group() this gives you per-group pre-processing (HVG, PCA, batch correction within a patient, kNN) followed by source-pure meta cells, which you then hand to merge_meta_cells().

Usage

step_metacells_sc(method = c("bootstrapped", "seacells", "supercells"), ...)

Arguments

method

String. One of c("bootstrapped", "seacells", "supercells").

...

Arguments passed on to the generator, e.g. sc_meta_cell_params, target_size or .verbose.

Value

An ScStep.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
pipeline <- step_hvg_sc() %>>%
  step_pca_sc(no_pcs = 20L) %>>%
  step_harmony_sc(batch_column = "plate") %>>%
  step_neighbours_sc(embd_to_use = "harmony") %>>%
  step_metacells_sc("bootstrapped")

per_patient <- apply_pipeline_per_group(pipeline, sc_obj, "patient_id")
mc <- merge_meta_cells(per_patient)
} # }
